prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 11 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1411; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a collision sustained while the patient's vehicle was struck during a left-hand turn. The reported mechanism is consistent with the shoulder injury diagnosed, and the force described fits the pattern of soft tissue damage seen in this type of impact. Over eleven visits, care included physical therapy, range-of-motion work, and home exercise instruction. Recovery ran somewhat longer than typically expected for this injury, which we attribute to the patient's pace of progress rather than any single setback. On examination, certain findings, including reduced active abduction and tenderness over the rotator cuff insertion, support the clinical diagnosis. Other tests, such as neurological screening and stability assessment, returned normal results. The patient reports a minor strain to the same region many years ago, which resolved completely without ongoing limitation and does not appear to affect the current presentation. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no repeated charges for the same services.
